messages:
maria: Heads-up — we have ~24 accounts flagged as impacted by the inference latency spike from 09:12–09:42 UTC. I’ve attached the export, see below. Need: customer-facing status, SLA mitigation proposal, and an onboarding queue check for any customers currently onboarding.

jordan: Confirmed from infra — GPU autoscaler briefly failed to add burst nodes due to a config race. Root cause is under triage. Latency returned after manual scale at 09:42. Logs: `autoscaler:error reconcile timeout` repeated.

taylor: @maria can you send the list? I’ll start drafting outreach for onboarding customers first (they're sensitive to delays).

maria: pasted the list here:
```
- acme-inc (onboarding: yes, enterprise)
- beta-ml (onboarding: no, large tenant)
- deltahealth (onboarding: yes, PII=true)
- shopwise (onboarding: no)
- 20 others...
```

kiran: For credits calc — our SLA policy says 10% service credit for incident >30m on Dedicated/reserved. For hosted API we'll do a pro-rated credit. I'll mock numbers and share.

li: Heads-up: two enterprise accounts in that list are up for renewal in 3 weeks (acme-inc, deltahealth). Need clear, empathetic messaging + mitigation steps.

elaine: Legal note — do not commit to compensation language beyond standard SLA in first comm. Offer 'we're assessing credits under SLA and will follow up with account-specific details.' Avoid admitting systemic negligence.

maria: Good call. Draft inbound to CS — short status update now, promise timeline for RCA and credits after SRE confirms root cause. Template below, feel free to edit: 

```
Hi {{customer_name}},

We’re reaching out about an incident this morning that affected inference latency between 09:12–09:42 UTC. Impact: transient increased latency and occasional 5xxs for some requests.

What we’re doing: our engineering team mitigated the immediate issue and are conducting a full RCA. We are also calculating any applicable credits under your SLA and will follow up with account-specific details by EOD tomorrow.

If you rely on onboarding support this week, we can prioritize sessions and extend your onboarding window; please reply if you’d like that.

Apologies for the disruption — we’re treating this as high priority.

Best,
Redwood Customer Success
```

jordan: SRE timeline: preliminary RCA by EOD today, full RCA + action items by EOD tomorrow. Root cause seems to be a race in autoscaler + a degraded monitoring alert that didn't page for duplicate failures.

taylor: I'll send the template to onboarding customers first and queue enterprise ones for AE + CS LU review before sending. I'll cc @li for renewals wording.

kiran: Credits estimate: for Dedicated tenants assume 10% of monthly committed usage for impacted window; for hosted we'll calculate pro-rated token/time credits. I’ll post a spreadsheet in 10–15m.

maria: Action items: 1) @jordan confirm timeline & short RCA snippet for comms (today). 2) @kiran publish credit estimates (15m). 3) @taylor send onboarding comms now (template above). 4) @li prepare renewal-facing note for acme-inc/deltahealth (hold for my review). 5) @elaine approve legal phrasing (now).

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-041: latency-spike — status: acknowledged, priority: P2, assigned: autoscaler-team.

elaine: approve the template with one tweak: change 'apologize' line to 'We apologize for any disruption' and keep credit phrasing as 'assessing credits under your SLA'.

maria: Updated template with legal tweak. @taylor please send and paste thread links here when done. @li I’ll DM you the renewal wording for sign-off.

taylor: Sent onboarding comms to 8 customers. Pasted the first message thread link: https://redwood.slack.com/archives/CUST-123/p1234567890 — will follow up with replies.

jordan: Posting quick RCA snippet for comms: "cause: autoscaler reconciliation race causing delayed burst provisioning; mitigation: fixed reconciliation lock and added additional alerting on provision failures." Use only the short high-level wording in customer messages.

maria: Thanks. I’ll compile a customer update bundle and follow up with credits spreadsheet once @kiran posts it. Once SRE finalizes full RCA tomorrow, we’ll send a formal RCA to impacted accounts.

kiran: Uploaded credits calc: https://s.redwood/internal/credits/incident-1812349999.xlsx — estimates ready.

li: I’ll prep renewal risk notes and escalation for acme-inc + deltahealth. On call with acme at 17:00 PT, will lead with mitigation + accelerated support offer.

maria: Great. Closing notes: keep replies short, escalate any customer asking for immediate refunds to me and legal. Thanks everyone. :pray:

(End of thread)
